name: Dependency scan
description: Runs the scanners you name, removes duplicates, ranks findings by reachability and proposes upgrades. The report stays private; a task per actionable finding. Every pull request needs your approval, and an unfixed weakness is never published.

repos.title: Repositories
repos.description: Repositories to scan, such as owner/repo.

scanners.title: Scanner commands
scanners.description: Commands run in each clone, such as: npm audit --json.

pr_repos.title: Repositories that may get upgrade pull requests

scanner_token.title: Scanner token
scanner_token.description: A Vault entry, for scanners that need a token.

secrets.name: SCANNER_TOKEN
secrets.description: Passed to the scanner commands through the Terminal tool's secrets, never printed.
